details: Early attendee arrival and orientation begins.
25 industry mentors from diverse sectors are present for informal engagement. Mentors and speakers are identifiable by name tags. A display board at the entrance lists each mentor's name and field.
Welcome by Priscillah Makola. Opening address by Cohen Appanah, with handover to Raksha Naidoo to introduce the panel.

Accelerate Your Career — The Moves That Matter. Moderator: Raksha Naidoo. Panelists: Zoliswa Tshetshe, Thabile Makgala, Edward Pitsi, Tony Lennox. 45-minute moderated discussion followed by a 30-minute audience Q&A.
Nathan Fletcher introduces the six breakaway rooms and outlines how the sessions work.
Lunch and informal interaction — an opportunity to connect with speakers, panelists, mentors, and peers.
Six rooms run simultaneously across four 30-minute rounds. Each room is interactive and includes facilitator input plus Q&A. Attendees may rotate between rooms.
